periods.time: before and during the coup five years earlier
periods.label: Silver-haired manipulator behind the empire's destruction
titles: former first prince figure of Arcadia Empire

status.secret: claims he was never truly an imperial prince

appearance.overview: handsome silver-haired youth with gray eyes, noble gestures, and predatory gaze

personality.summary: amused, ruthless, manipulative, and philosophical about power and evil
personality.inner_conflict: none explicit; he rejects Lux's idealism

quote_samples: 你啊，完全不了解这个世界。根本不具备王的器量，你这个最弱。

mannerisms: lectures Lux on kingship and evil

background.upbringing: presented as Lux's elder half-brother and retired first prince, but later claims this identity is false
formative_events: used the flute and killed spared imperial elites
background.pre_story: visited Lux before the coup and pressed him to choose how to fight

lux-arcadia.summary: encouraged and used Lux's plan, then betrayed his ideals and vanished

lisha-atismata.summary: gives young Lisha a Sword Device and tells her to escape the burning castle

belbet-balt.summary: Belbet later uses a similar flute-connected power, implying Fugil's methods persist

periods.summary: Fugil is the silver-haired man in the prologue and Lux's apparent elder brother. He gives Lisha a Sword Device, manipulates Lux's anti-imperial plan, uses the flute to summon Abyss, murders imperial survivors, and disappears after declaring Lux's idealism weakest.

key_events.summary: Gives young Lisha a Sword Device and sends her away during the burning of the imperial castle.
Kills the spared imperial court, reveals he used Lux's plan, and rejects Lux's ideals.
